3.note:
The parameterized lookup control uses 100 and 300 rows in whole-list and preview modes, plus an entry with no summary. A Proxy counts native task-map reads: preparation equals the uninstrumented result with size + 1 reads; mounted HTML is identical, qualified child navigation is checked, and preview shows five rows. In whole-list mode the missing-document row is observed before clicking the number and completed sort controls. After those clicks the test asserts only the total read bound, reads <= (size + 1) * 4; it does not reassert that row's presence or position. This is source-defined evidence, not a fresh test, timing or performance run; no docPath getter is instrumented.
